review_kind: Codex qualitative reading against recorded evidence; not independent biological validation

provider_latency_seconds.note: sum of inference request durations per conversation; excludes SSH and guard overhead

case_reviews.finding: Recognizes completed nodes and asks for output checks; no biological validation claimed.
Recognizes technical success; recommendations remain generic.

case_reviews.answer_issue: Claims one node was executed and that output data was generated. The evidence provided does not establish those claims.

case_reviews.evidence: error_text: exhausted 24576 MiB RAM and 1536 MiB swap; systemd OOM
case_reviews.finding: Correctly identifies RAM/swap exhaustion, suggests memory/pool/batch checks; memory configuration advice is generic.

case_reviews.judgement: correct error identification; unsafe ambiguity in correction
case_reviews.evidence: LegacyFrameSelectionLimit; only a prefix starting at frame 1 is supported
case_reviews.answer_issue: Conflates a contiguous absolute-frame prefix 1:N with using relative indices. Renumbering arbitrary requested frames is not a validated fix.

case_reviews.evidence: snapshot status running, computeDrift output; a second capture exists
case_reviews.answer_issue: Does not consult get_progress_history. Heartbeat proves worker liveness, not continuing scientific progress; suggests a restart condition without evidence of a stall.

case_reviews.judgement: scope interpreted correctly; progress proof incorrect
case_reviews.evidence: latest_event scope parallel_fov; ROI extraction 6/9, localValue 0.8631578947
case_reviews.finding: Keeps 86.32% local to ROI extraction and avoids ETA. Incorrectly treats the recent heartbeat as proof of real progress; does not compare snapshots.

case_reviews.judgement: partly supported frame progress; ambiguous remaining work
case_reviews.answer_issue: Acknowledges frame progress is not whole-job completion but then states 54% of work remains without keeping the scope explicit. No history consultation.

case_reviews.finding: Identifies node and table-dimension error; generic input/model reset or update suggestions do not locate the exact failing assignment or prove a repair.

case_reviews.evidence: Index in position 4 exceeds array bounds. Index must not exceed 13
case_reviews.answer_issue: Says index 4 is invalid for an array of size 13 and invents failure at step 4. Position 4 refers to the fourth subscript/dimension; the actual offending index is not supplied.

case_reviews.judgement: correct missing-channel category; unsupported channel-specific cause
case_reviews.evidence: cellpose_sam_segmentatio: input channel not found: (no input channel configured)
case_reviews.answer_issue: Turns the log into a claim that channel 0 TL _z2 is missing. A name in parameters is not evidence that this exact channel was the unresolved runtime input.

recommendation: Feasible for a bounded shared-GPU pilot and simple log explanation. Not ready to prepare or launch runs autonomously; deterministic progress-history aggregation and parameter validation remain necessary. Compare 8B/14B on the same frozen corpus when resources permit.
limitations: 11 recorded cases, temperature 0, one checkpoint; no isolated GPU latency baseline and no completed 4/8-bit quantization comparison.
